content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Biloxi

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review your academic background and documented hours leading projects or project teams. PMI sets specific thresholds; Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can help you confirm readiness before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Attend scheduled sessions from your Biloxi location; interact with certified instructors in real time, ask questions, and work through case studies. You'll earn the formal contact hours PMI requires to sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Application & Exam Fee
steps_items.text: After completing your contact hours, submit your PMI application directly through the PMI website. Provide your training documentation from Granite PM Academy and pay the designated exam fee. PMI processes applications within a standard timeframe; you'll receive approval to schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours—to build confidence. Schedule your exam at a PMI Pearson VUE testing center accessible to you. On test day, apply the knowledge and domain expertise you've developed throughout the course.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to the standard three-year renewal cycle. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteer work, or formal training. Renew your credential before expiration to keep your PMP active and demonstrate your ongoing commitment to project management excellence.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
